fields.statement: done-own-command-guide is updated in this change set to follow the split, not by keeping the rule in the review index: build.md keeps the own-command rule for builders and verifiers unchanged, and on the review side the rule lives in the shared done block expanded into every review role topic (check-compliance, check-quality, check-qa, check-model, critic, fixer, ci-fix, gate-fix and conflict-fix), not in review.md. Its statement names the build topic, the review role topics and the builtin prompts, and its acceptance becomes: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... asserts build.md and each of the nine expanded review role topics hold the own-command rule (run rhiza session done as its own command, only after the recording command succeeded, never chained with ; or &&); go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow asserts no prompt in internal/workflow/builtin/*.toml contains '; rhiza session done' or '&& rhiza session done' and every prompt that still names rhiza session done says it is the very last action (one-line /rhiza-<role> prompts that no longer name it pass).
